name: PdxRelativeTime
description: Shows a time relative to now ("3 hours ago", "in 2 days"), locale-aware and kept up to date.

members.name: datetime
members.description: The date/time to render relative to now.

members.name: locale
members.description: Locale of the wording. Empty: the page's language (`lang`), then the browser's.

members.name: updateInterval
members.description: How often (ms) to refresh the text.

members.name: showTooltip
members.description: Shows the absolute date on hover.
